data.body: Investigation: 22 source-grepping instances across 9 test files. Most check architectural contracts (SIGURG handler, version bump phase, retry logic) that require execution mocks with fake git environments to convert properly. Converting all instances would be a dedicated multi-story effort, not a single bug fix. Partial conversion risks leaving inconsistent test coverage. Recommend creating a story in the testing-quality epic to tackle this systematically. Not fixable in a debug session without significant regression risk.
